$comment: Exact rendered typography exceptions. A rule requires every listed class and the exact computed triple; zero matches or changed expected counts fail the gate. Remove rules when their scoped exceptions are retired. These are not consumer styles.

documented.reason: Small initials use Label/XS with semibold weight: 11/16/600. Keep both classes; other Avatar sizes use complete semantic steps.
Menu labels use Body/XS with semibold weight: 12/18/600. The ramp has no complete step for these metrics.
The decorative check glyph uses an internal 10px size: 10/15/400. No semantic text style has these metrics; do not copy this raw size into consumer text.
